coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across five major angles: (1) Graph database ecosystems (Neo4j, TigerGraph, ArangoDB, competitors), (2) Data visualization platforms & integrations (Metabase, Superset, Grafana, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Kibana), (3) Low-code/no-code automation platforms (Retool, Appsmith, Budibase, n8n, Activepieces), (4) Modern data stack (Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, BigQuery), and (5) Integration platforms (Zapier, Make, MCP ecosystem). Verified live URLs for key sources including official product docs (Figma, dbt, Snowflake), analyst reports (Gartner, Forrester, Fortune Business Insights, Mordor Intelligence), and review aggregators (G2, Capterra). Deduplicated across 45+ searches. Notable gaps: Internal product roadmaps (proprietary), some paywalled analyst reports (Gartner Magic Quadrant access restrictions), live pricing pages (subject to frequent change). Key ICP-relevant sources emphasize: Figma/Google Drive integration surface, vector DB ecosystems (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus), semantic layers (dbt MetricFlow), real-time collaboration features, MCP protocol adoption for AI agents, graph visualization library ecosystem (D3, Cytoscape, Vega), and data warehouse partnerships.
